fullDescription: Warm hand-drawn illustrated pastel hero section for an AI design product: cream paper ground with a friendly sky-blue + coral accent duo, Poppins type, a big extrabold headline with a hand-drawn coral squiggle underline, a sky pill CTA + avatar social proof, and a playful illustration zone (sky gradient circle, rotating dashed ring, tilted ink-outlined mock screen, and floating component/prompt pills). Cheerful, approachable, craft-y, mobile-clip fixed.

structured.summary: A warm, hand-drawn illustrated pastel hero section for an AI design product (placeholder brand 'Palette'). Cream paper ground (#fdf9f3) with a friendly sky-blue (#38bdf8) + coral (#fb7185) accent duo and near-black ink (#26222e) text in Poppins. Top-down: a full-bleed ink announcement strip, a sticky blurred cream nav with a rounded logo badge, then a 2-column hero: LEFT a coral uppercase eyebrow pill, a big extrabold headline with a hand-drawn coral squiggle underline on the phrase 'one prompt', a slate sub-paragraph, a sky-pill primary CTA + white outline 'watch demo' CTA, and an avatar-stack social-proof row; RIGHT a playful illustration zone — a big sky-blue gradient circle behind a slowly-rotating dashed ring, a tilted hand-drawn 'mock screen' card, and four floating glass/white info pills (prompt chip, components count, 'design ready' badge, 'copy as React' dark chip) with gentle floaty animations and little sparkle accents. Soft blurred background blobs in sky + coral. The whole thing reads cheerful, approachable and craft-y, not corporate.

style.description: Warm illustrated pastel / hand-drawn friendly SaaS aesthetic. Cream paper base (#fdf9f3) instead of white, with a two-accent system: sky blue (#38bdf8) as the primary action color and coral/pink (#fb7185, deep variant #b21748 for text-on-pale) as the playful spark. All text is near-black ink (#26222e) with a soft slate (#6b6477) for secondary copy. Type is Poppins throughout (400-800), rounded and friendly, with very tight tracking on the big extrabold headline. Generous rounding everywhere: pill buttons (rounded-full), 2xl/3xl cards, a custom 'huge' 2.5rem radius. Soft layered shadows (soft-shadow 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(38,34,46,0.22), card-shadow 0 14px 30px -12px rgba(38,34,46,0.20)) give a gentle lifted feel. Hand-drawn craft signals: an SVG squiggle underline under the headline accent phrase, a tilted (rotate -2deg) ink-outlined 'mock screen' card with traffic-light dots, a slowly rotating dashed ring, floating white info pills, and ph:sparkle/ph:star accents. Subtle motion: 5-7s ease-in-out floaty translateY loops on the pills/illustration and a 26s linear spin on the dashed ring, all disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. Large blurred sky/coral radial blobs sit behind the hero at low opacity. Mood: friendly, approachable, optimistic, crafted by hand, never cold or enterprise-grey.
style.prompt: Design in a warm illustrated pastel, hand-drawn friendly style. Palette: cream paper background #fdf9f3 (use it instead of pure white), sky blue #38bdf8 (primary action / illustration), coral #fb7185 (playful accent) with a deep coral-ink #b21748 for coral text on pale fills, near-black ink #26222e for text and outlines, soft slate #6b6477 for secondary copy. Type: Poppins for everything (weights 400-800); the hero H1 is extrabold (800), tight tracking, leading ~1.04, scaling ~44px (mobile) -> 56px -> 62px (desktop); body copy ~17-18px in slate. Rounding is generous and friendly: pill buttons use rounded-full, cards use rounded-2xl/3xl, plus a custom 'huge' 2.5rem radius; eyebrow + chips are full pills. Shadows are soft and warm, never harsh: soft-shadow = 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(38,34,46,0.22), card-shadow = 0 14px 30px -12px rgba(38,34,46,0.20). Buttons: a primary sky-blue pill (bg #38bdf8, ink #26222e text, soft-shadow, hover lifts -translate-y-0.5 and slightly darkens) and a secondary white pill with a 2px ink/15 border (a coral ph:play-circle icon). Hand-drawn craft is the signature: draw an SVG squiggle underline (coral stroke #fb7185, width ~5, round caps, a gentle wavy path) under the headline accent phrase; render a tilted (rotate -2deg) 'mock screen' as an ink-outlined (border-2 border-ink/85) cream card with three traffic-light dots (coral / sky / ink-25), skeleton text bars, a 2-up tile grid (sky-tint + coral-tint), and a dark 'Ship it' button; place a slowly rotating dashed ring (SVG circle, ink stroke at ~14% opacity, dash 3 9) and a large sky-gradient circle behind it; scatter floating white/ink info pills and ph:sparkle / ph:star accents. Animate gently: 5-7s ease-in-out floaty translateY loops on the pills + illustration, a 26s linear spin on the dashed ring, all turned off under prefers-reduced-motion. Behind the hero, add two large low-opacity blurred radial blobs (sky/10 and coral/10). Icons are Phosphor (Iconify ph:*-fill mostly). Keep the mood cheerful, approachable, hand-crafted and optimistic; sky is the workhorse and coral is the spark used sparingly.

layout_and_structure.description: A single hero screen, content centered in a max-w-[1180px] container with px-6 gutters. Top-down: (1) a full-bleed ink announcement strip (centered) with a small coral sparkle badge, an announcement line and a sky 'Browse the library' link; (2) a sticky (top-0, z-50) full-bleed nav bar with a blurred cream/85 background and a hairline bottom border — left = rounded sky logo badge (ph:palette-fill) with a tiny coral notification dot + 'Palette' wordmark, center = 4 nav links (shown only at lg) in slate, right = a 'Log in' text link (sm+) and a sky pill CTA 'Start designing'; (3) the hero as a 2-column grid (lg:grid-cols-[1.05fr_1fr], gap-12/10) — LEFT a coral uppercase eyebrow pill, the extrabold H1 with a hand-drawn squiggle underline on 'one prompt', a slate sub-paragraph, a CTA row (sky primary pill + white outline 'watch the 60s demo'), and a social-proof row (overlapping avatar circles + '9k+' chip + a 'Loved by 9,000+ builders' line); RIGHT a fixed-height illustration zone holding a big sky-gradient circle, a rotating dashed ring, a tilted ink-outlined mock-screen card, and four absolutely-positioned floating info pills plus sparkle/star accents. Responsive: nav center links appear only at lg; the 'Log in' link and some inline copy hide on small screens; the 2-col hero stacks to a single column below lg; the illustration zone scales its height (440px -> 500px -> 540px) and the floating pills reposition (sm: offsets) so they stay inside the frame; the original mobile clip was fixed by giving the illustration column horizontal padding + a max-width and nudging the pill offsets so nothing overflows the viewport on phones.

prompts.prompt: A full-bleed bar with an ink background (#26222e) and cream text. Inside a centered max-w-[1180px] row (justify-center, gap-2, py-2.5, text ~13-14px): a small coral circle badge holding a tiny ink ph:sparkle-fill, the line 'New: 2,400+ community prompts just landed.' in cream/90, and a sky-colored 'Browse the library' link (font-semibold) with a ph:arrow-up-right-bold that nudges right on hover.

A sticky top header (top-0, z-50, full width) with a translucent cream/85 background, backdrop-blur-md and a hairline ink/5 bottom border. Inside max-w-[1180px], py-3.5: left = a brand link — a 9x9 rounded-2xl sky badge with soft-shadow holding an ink ph:palette-fill, a tiny coral notification dot (ring-2 ring-cream) at its top-right, and an extrabold 'Palette' wordmark (~19px); center = a horizontal list (hidden, shown at lg) of medium slate links 'Prompt library / How it works / Templates / Pricing' that darken to ink on hover; right = a 'Log in' text link (hidden below sm) and a sky pill CTA 'Start designing' (rounded-full, ink text, soft-shadow, ph:arrow-right-bold, hover lifts).

The left column (max-w-xl) of the 2-col hero. Top: a coral eyebrow pill — rounded-full, bg coral/15, deep coral-ink text #b21748, uppercase, tracking ~0.14em, ~12.5px, with a ph:magic-wand-fill icon and the label 'AI design, your way'. Then an extrabold Poppins H1 (tracking-tight, leading 1.04, ~44/56/62px) reading 'Beautiful UI, one prompt away.' where the phrase 'one prompt' is wrapped in a relative inline-block with a hand-drawn coral SVG squiggle underline (path stroke #fb7185, width 5, round caps) sitting just below it. Then a slate sub-paragraph (~17-18px, leading-relaxed): 'Palette turns plain words into shippable screens. Start from 2,400+ hand-picked prompts, remix on an infinite canvas, and hand clean code to your favorite coding agent.' Then a CTA row (mt-9, column on mobile, row on sm): a primary sky pill 'Start designing free' (rounded-full, px-7 py-4, ink text, soft-shadow, ph:arrow-right-bold that nudges on hover, hover lifts) and a secondary white outline pill 'Watch the 60s demo' (rounded-full, border-2 border-ink/15, white bg, coral ph:play-circle-fill). Then a trust row (mt-9): a set of overlapping (-space-x-2.5) 9x9 avatar circles (sky/20, coral/20, ink/10 each with a ph:user-fill, ring-2 ring-cream) ending in a white '9k+' chip, beside a two-line note '“Loved by 9,000+ builders” / designing without the blank canvas.' with 'Loved by 9,000+ builders' in semibold ink and the rest in slate.

The right column: a relative, mx-auto, fixed-height block (h-440px mobile -> 500px sm -> 540px lg, with px-6 on mobile and a max-w cap ~420/480px so it never overflows the phone viewport). Layered, all absolutely centered: (1) a big soft circle — h/w ~330/370/400px, rounded-full, bg-gradient-to-br from sky/75 to sky, with two small blurred inner blobs (white/25 top-left, coral/25 bottom-right); (2) a slowly rotating dashed ring — an SVG circle slightly larger than the circle (h/w ~360/460/500px), ink stroke at 14% opacity, stroke-dasharray '3 9', spinning 26s linear; (3) a tilted hand-drawn mock-screen card centered inside the circle — w ~230/252px, rounded-3xl, border-2 border-ink/85, bg cream, card-shadow, rotate -2deg: a row of 3 traffic-light dots (coral / sky / ink-25), a 3/4-width ink-85 title bar, two ink/15 skeleton lines, a 2-col tile grid (a sky/25 tile with a sky ph:image-square-fill, a coral/25 tile with a coral ph:chart-bar-fill), and a dark ink 'Ship it' pill with cream text. Then four absolutely-positioned floating info pills, each white (or ink) with card-shadow and a gentle floaty animation: (a) top-left rounded-full white pill — coral ph:chat-circle-text-fill chip + '"a SaaS dashboard"'; (b) top-right rounded-2xl white card — sky ph:squares-four-fill tile + '128 components / ready to drop in'; (c) bottom-right rounded-2xl white card (slower float) — a coral-gradient circle with a ph:check-bold + 'Design ready / in 8 seconds'; (d) bottom-left rounded-full ink pill — sky ph:code-fill + 'Copy as React' in cream. Plus a coral ph:sparkle-fill (top-right) and a white ph:star-fill (left-center) accent, both gently floating. Position the pills with sm: offset overrides so they stay inside the frame across breakpoints.

special_ui_components.prompt: Hand-drawn coral SVG squiggle underline (wavy path, round caps, stroke #fb7185) under the headline accent phrase 'one prompt'
Tilted (rotate -2deg) hand-drawn 'mock screen' card: ink-outlined cream card with traffic-light dots, skeleton text/image bars, a 2-up sky/coral tile grid and a dark 'Ship it' button
Slowly rotating dashed ring (SVG circle, ink stroke ~14% opacity, dash 3 9, 26s linear spin) layered behind/around a big sky-blue gradient circle
Four floating glass/white info pills with gentle floaty translateY animations: a prompt chip, a '128 components' card, a 'Design ready in 8 seconds' badge, and a dark 'Copy as React' chip
Coral uppercase eyebrow pill (bg coral/15, deep coral-ink #b21748 text, ph:magic-wand-fill) above the headline
Overlapping avatar-stack social-proof row (sky/coral/ink circles + a '9k+' chip + 'Loved by 9,000+ builders' copy)
Sky-blue pill primary CTA + white 2px-outline secondary CTA (with a coral play icon)
Soft blurred radial background blobs (sky/10, coral/10) and ph:sparkle / ph:star accent marks
prefers-reduced-motion guard that disables all the floaty + spin animations

Phosphor (Iconify ph:*) icons throughout: palette-fill, magic-wand-fill, arrow-right-bold, arrow-up-right-bold, play-circle-fill, sparkle-fill, star-fill, user-fill, chat-circle-text-fill, squares-four-fill, image-square-fill, chart-bar-fill, check-bold, code-fill

structured.special_notes: Font loaded from Google Fonts: Poppins (400/500/600/700/800) used for all text. Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme palette (cream #fdf9f3, sky #38bdf8, coral #fb7185, coralink #b21748, ink #26222e, slate #6b6477) plus a custom borderRadius 'huge' 2.5rem. Icons via the Iconify web component (ph:* / Phosphor set). The page background is cream (#fdf9f3), never pure white. Custom CSS defines soft-shadow / card-shadow and the floaty / floaty-slow / spin-slow keyframes, all disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. This is the mobile-clip-fixed revision: the illustration column carries horizontal padding + a max-width and the floating pill offsets are nudged (sm: overrides) so nothing overflows the viewport on small screens; the whole hero stacks to a single column below lg and the nav center links + 'Log in' appear only at larger breakpoints. Keep sky as the primary workhorse accent and coral as the playful spark used sparingly; the mood must stay warm, hand-drawn and friendly, never cold, white or enterprise-grey.
